comment:
* A class which holds the unread messages from a conversation.
         *
         * @deprecated {@link UnreadConversation} is no longer supported. Use {@link MessagingStyle}
         * instead.

methods.name: public String @Nullable [] getMessages()
methods.comment: * Gets the list of messages conveyed by this notification.

methods.name: public RemoteInput getRemoteInput()
methods.comment:
* Gets the remote input that will be used to convey the response to a message list, or
             * null if no such remote input exists.

methods.name: public PendingIntent getReplyPendingIntent()
methods.comment:
* Gets the pending intent that will be triggered when the user replies to this
             * notification.

methods.name: public PendingIntent getReadPendingIntent()
methods.comment:
* Gets the pending intent that Android Auto will send after it reads aloud all messages
             * in this object's message list.

methods.name: public String @Nullable [] getParticipants()
methods.comment: * Gets the participants in the conversation.

methods.name: public String getParticipant()
methods.comment: * Gets the firs participant in the conversation.

methods.name: public long getLatestTimestamp()
methods.comment: * Gets the timestamp of the conversation.
